description: This file contains shell functions for manipulating and analyzing filesystem images, including identifying filesystem types based on magic words, calculating padding, and rounding numbers.

methods.name: get_magic_word
methods.description: Reads the first 4 bytes of a filesystem image file to identify its magic word.

methods.name: get_post_padding_word
methods.description: Calculates and retrieves a 4-byte word from the end of a filesystem image, considering alignment constraints.

methods.name: get_fs_type
methods.description: Determines the filesystem type (e.g., ubifs, squashfs, squashfs-jffs2, or unknown) based on magic words and padding.

methods.name: round_up
methods.description: Rounds up a number to the nearest multiple of a given value.
